info.title: Data Pipelines API
info.description: Create and manage a continious pipeline with an external warehouse.

server.description:
The server location to be used:
  * `data` - The default (US) servers used for most projects
  * `data-eu` - EU servers if you are enrolled in EU Data Residency

tags.name: Create Pipelines
tags.description: Operations to add schemas to a project

post.description:
This request creates an export pipeline. The `type` parameter defines the kind of pipeline that is initiated.

Create API returns the name of the pipeline created. Use the name of the pipeline to check the status of or cancel the pipeline.

200.description: Returns the name of the pipeline created. Use the name of the pipeline to check the status of or cancel the pipeline.

project_id.description: must be specified when using service account based authentication

type.description:
**type** parameters include `s3-raw`, `gcs-raw`, and `azure-raw`.

Initializes s3-raw, gcs-raw, or azure-raw pipelines accordingly.

trial.description:
**Default**: `false`

A trial pipeline will be created if value is true.

The trial exports all of your events and user data for thirty calendar days, starting from one day before the API call was made. A trial pipeline has default values for the following parameters:

**data_source**: `events and people`
**sync**: `false`
**from_date**: `<defaults to previous day>`
**to_date**: `<no value>`
**frequency**: `daily`
**events**: `<no value>`

schema_type.description:
**Default**: `monoschema`

Allowed options are `monoschema` and `multischema`. `monoschema` loads all events into a single table. `multischema` loads every event into its own dedicated table. All user data is exported as `monoschema`.

data_source.description:
**Default**: `events`

**data_source** can be either `events` or `people`. `events` exports Mixpanel event data. `people` exports Mixpanel user data.

sync.description:
**Default**: `false`

A value of `true` updates exported data with any changes that occur in your Mixpanel dataset. These changes include deletions, late data, and imports that fall into your export window.

from_date.description:
The starting date of the export window. It is formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

If **trial** is set to `true` this will default to the previous day; otherwise, it is a required parameter.

to_date.description: The ending date of the export window. It is formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD`. The export will continue indefinitely if **to_date** is empty.

frequency.description:
**Default**: `daily`

**frequency** can be either `hourly` or `daily`. `hourly` exports the data every hour. `daily` exports the data at midnight (based on the projects timezone). **frequency** should only be passed if your export window is indefinite.

events.description:
A whitelist for the event you intend to export. It is okay to pass this multiple times to whitelist multiple events.

All events in the project will be exported if no events are specified.

where.description: A selector expression used to filter by events data, such as event properties. Learn more about how to construct event selector expressions here. This parameter is only valid when **data_source** is `events`.

data_format.description:
**Default**: `json`

The file format of the exported data. **data_format** can be either `json` or `parquet`.

gcs_bucket.description:
*Required if **type** is `gcs-raw`

The GCS bucket to export the Mixpanel data to.

gcs_prefix.description:
*Required if **type** is `gcs-raw`

The GCS path prefix of the bucket.

gcs_region.description:
*Required if **type** is `gcs-raw`

The GCS region for the bucket.

project_id.description: must be specified when using service account based authentication

s3_bucket.description: The S3 bucket to which the data needs to be exported.

s3_region.description: The valid S3 region for the bucket.

s3_role.description: There is no default value. AWS Role the writer should assume when writing to s3.

s3_prefix.description: There is no default value. The path prefix for the export.

s3_encryption.description:
**Default**: `none`

Options are `none`, `aes` and `kms`. At rest encryption used by the s3 bucket.

s3_kms_key_id.description: There is no default value. If s3_encryption is set to kms, this can specify the custom key id you desire to use.

glue_database.description:
Required if **use_glue** is `true`.

The glue database to which the schema needs to be exported.

glue_role.description:
Required if **use_glue** is `true`.

There is no default value. The role that needs to be assumed for updating glue.

glue_table_prefix.description: There is no default value. Prefix to add to table names when creating them.
